title: Hooked on Travel
description:
S01 E12 — Meandering Trout
Any river in which both Brown and Rainbow Trout thrive is sure to attract Jerry and Gareth to throw a fly in amongst, but when they find a stretch that flows into a dam thousands of acres in size.

description:

Algoa Bay is to many rock and surf anglers' favorite destination, a fishing mecca.

title: Inside Angling
description:
S01 E01 — Beasts of Barotse
We head off to the untamed wilds of Zambia's Lozi Kingdom to take on the monsters of the Zambezi River. From tigerfish to nembwe, this area never fails to provide trophy fishing.

A challenge is laid down to see who rules the roost in WildFly country and a fierce competition for bragging rights ensues. The crew soon learn that there is only one real competition and that's between fish and angler.
